description: This file defines a React hook 'useFilterScope' that computes the scope of filters in a dashboard, based on layout, chart IDs, and filter scope parameters. It includes utility functions for extracting labels from layout items and handles various scope scenarios such as all charts, specific tabs, or specific charts, considering exclusions.

methods.name: extractTabLabel
methods.description: Extracts label text from a layout tab item, prioritizing 'text', then 'defaultText', then 'id'.

methods.name: extractChartLabel
methods.description: Extracts label for a chart from a layout item, prioritizing 'sliceNameOverride', then 'sliceName', then 'id'.
